paper_question: Does the method improve local structural validity?
required_evidence: Paired outcome-unseen comparison on identical Source records
current_evidence: DEV: Source V3D about 0.4204; Restricted 0.5645±0.0017 and Unrestricted 0.5681±0.0011 across seeds
notes: V3D is the primary structural-validity endpoint

paper_question: Is the effect stable to training randomness?
required_evidence: Matched formulations and seeds with fixed endpoint
current_evidence: Six complete GPU runs; multiseed integrity PASS
notes: Do not treat n=3 as high-powered population inference

paper_question: Does it generalize beyond TRAIN molecules?
required_evidence: Molecule-disjoint evaluation
current_evidence: DEV has 2500 molecules and zero molecule overlap with TRAIN
notes: TRAIN-unseen DEV is not a protected final test

paper_question: Does it generalize to completely development-unseen molecules?
required_evidence: One-shot zero-TRAIN/DEV-overlap same-upstream final cohort
current_evidence: No valid primary cohort is ready as-is
missing: Primary cohort identity and outcome-blind protocol freeze
notes: Formal has TRAIN overlap; DiTMC holdout is secondary only

paper_question: Does it generalize across upstream generators?
required_evidence: Frozen current-method evaluation on a disjoint alternate-upstream cohort
current_evidence: DiTMC large-holdout metadata exists; outcomes closed
protocol_status: Legacy protocol requires current identity freeze
notes: Not required for ETFlow-scoped claim

paper_question: Does refinement preserve the input conformation?
required_evidence: Raw displacement and aligned Source RMSD with tails
current_evidence: Three-seed raw displacement: Restricted about 0.00555 Å; Unrestricted about 0.00616 Å
metric: Raw Source displacement RMS; Kabsch Source RMSD; movement tails
notes: Restricted/Unrestricted form a source-fidelity trade-off

paper_question: Does refinement recover the Reference conformer?
required_evidence: Frozen correspondence and ensemble-min Kabsch RMSD
current_evidence: Reference RMSD about 1.31964 Å for both; essentially unchanged
protocol_status: Fixed-order all-atom Kabsch PASS; no symmetry search
notes: Use as contextual locality metric, not headline improvement

paper_question: Does refinement improve continuous local geometry?
required_evidence: Paired continuous Bond/Angle errors
current_evidence: Bond and cosine-Angle MAE plus internal objective are complete on DEV
metric: Bond raw MAE; cosine-Angle raw MAE
notes: Diagnostic/secondary endpoints explain V3D

paper_question: Does refinement preserve broader chemical plausibility?
required_evidence: Independent validity battery and every component
current_evidence: PoseBusters about 0.9323–0.9324 across formulations/seeds; components complete
notes: Partially overlaps V3D but adds sanitization/connectivity/radicals/planarity

paper_question: Does refinement improve single-point energy?
required_evidence: Matched Source/proposal single-point calculations with robust tails
current_evidence: GFN2-xTB 6.7.1: negative median at all formulation/seed runs; 5000/5000 success each
metric: Median deltaE; fraction below zero; trimmed mean; quantiles; tails
missing: Protected final replication and matched MMFF energy evaluation
notes: Arithmetic mean is secondary because of rare catastrophic tails

paper_question: Is learned refinement valuable versus inexpensive classical optimization?
required_evidence: Exact-record MMFF94s optimization and identical downstream evaluation
current_evidence: No exact final matched baseline
metric: V3D; PB; RMSDs; xTB single point; runtime; failures
notes: Submission-critical conventional baseline

paper_question: Is it valuable versus GFN2-xTB optimization?
required_evidence: Matched optimization quality/cost comparison
current_evidence: Only GFN2-xTB single-point evaluation exists
missing: Only needed for physics-optimization superiority claim
notes: Strongly useful but optional for narrow local-refinement claim

paper_question: Is the method computationally efficient?
required_evidence: Synchronized inference benchmark and fair baseline wall times
current_evidence: Training times and peak training memory exist; inference latency/throughput does not
metric: Params; latency; throughput; GPU memory; preprocessing
notes: Cannot claim efficiency from training logs

paper_question: Is improvement broadly distributed across molecules?
required_evidence: Molecule-cluster paired effects and win/tie/loss
current_evidence: Aggregate and molecule-cluster bootstrap exist; paper-ready paired distributions are incomplete
protocol_status: Molecule is the correct cluster unit
notes: Two records per molecule must not be treated as independent

paper_question: Does the method avoid conformer collapse?
required_evidence: Within-molecule source-versus-refined diversity preservation
current_evidence: Two matched records per DEV molecule and tiny movements make a low-cost check possible
metric: Within-molecule pairwise Kabsch RMSD change; identity preservation
notes: More appropriate than standard COV/AMR

paper_question: Does the method improve ensemble coverage?
required_evidence: Generated and reference ensembles with frozen thresholds and matching
current_evidence: The method produces one refined counterpart per Source record, not a new sampled ensemble
notes: Do not force conformer-generation metrics into one-to-one refinement

paper_question: Is benefit understood across difficult cases?
required_evidence: Predeclared small subgroup set
current_evidence: Seed307 size/flexibility/source-quality stratifications exist
metric: Paired V3D and energy effects by Source quality/flexibility/size
missing: Final Source-quality/initial-failure subgroup; size/flexibility high value
notes: Avoid broad subgroup fishing

paper_question: Does the method improve downstream prediction or docking?
required_evidence: Task-specific downstream benchmark
current_evidence: No current downstream pipeline or artifact establishes this
notes: Do not create a new downstream study merely for breadth

paper_question: Are the two operating points scientifically distinct?
required_evidence: Matched multiseed trade-off on quality, locality and tails
current_evidence: Unrestricted consistently improves V3D/xTB median; Restricted moves less and has safer tails
metric: V3D; xTB median/tails; displacement; PB; Reference RMSD
notes: Predeclare both; no protected-outcome winner selection

required_evidence: Immutable code/config/checkpoint/evaluator/environment/result closure
current_evidence: Files and SHA256 exist but authoritative work remains untracked
